_readme: Committed floors for the OpenSSF Scorecard run in .github/workflows/openssf-scorecard.yml.
The gate is .harness/scripts/ci/52-validate-scorecard-regression.mjs: a run scoring below any
floor recorded here fails the workflow, so a posture regression is a red scheduled job and a
diffable fact rather than a number inside an artifact nobody opens.
aggregate is null on purpose. No Scorecard run has ever executed against this repository -- the
workflow landed on main on 2026-07-29 and its first scheduled trigger has not fired, and the
public OpenSSF API returns 404 for github.com/beyondnetcode/evolith_arch32. Inventing floors
without an observed run would produce a file that looks like a measurement and is not one, which
is the exact defect GT-597 exists to remove. While aggregate is null the gate fails CLOSED and
prints the exact document to commit.
SEEDING (repository owner): run the OpenSSF Scorecard workflow (Actions -> OpenSSF Scorecard ->
Run workflow). The gate step prints a ready-to-commit replacement for this file. Commit it, and
from then on every weekly run compares against it.
RATCHETING: a check scoring above its floor never fails the gate; it is reported as a suggestion.
Raising a floor stays a reviewed commit, because a baseline that updates itself cannot detect
